Title: Hydroponic Microgreens: Seed Rates, Light, EC & Harvest Days
Description: Hydroponic microgreens: 10–28 g seed per 10×20 in tray, 16–18 h of light (DLI 9–16), EC about 1.0 at pH 5.5–6.0. Cut at 2–3 in after 7–21 days. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: microgreen hydroponic system, hydroponics, indoor gardening, grow vegetables indoors
